meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在动手前会先把代码库里的每个源文件完整读一遍，大文件会分页读取，直到全部读完。它是为了借通读建立对项目代码的深入认识，方便后续一起开发。
howto.when: 当你开始处理一个新项目或不熟悉的代码库，或直接说“learn the codebase”“read the codebase”“prime”等请求时，就会触发它。

say.text: 先把这个代码库完整读一遍，然后告诉我项目结构。
say.note: 它会逐个文件读完后再回答。

say.text: 我刚接手这个项目，请先了解所有源代码再动手改。
say.note: 它会完整读取，耗时可能较长。

say.text: 请帮我学习一下代码库，之后回答我的问题。
say.note: 它会基于读到的内容来回答。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude systematically reads every source file in full, paging through large files, to build a deep understanding of the project before doing any further work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say things like "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", or "prime" to request it.

say_en.text: Please read through this codebase in full first, then tell me the structure.
say_en.note: It reads every file before answering.

say_en.text: I'm new to this project—please get up to speed on the source code before editing.
say_en.note: It will read every file completely; may take time.

say_en.text: Help me learn the codebase before answering my questions.
say_en.note: It will base answers on what it read.
